spanish.r-short.c1.0006.problem: Text contradicts itself: Medellín is called a small village in the south 30 km from the coast, later 'en el centro del país'; and 'mi madre es de aquí, pero mi padre es colombiano' gives no basis for two nationalities. Q(b) and Q(l) clash.
spanish.r-short.c1.0006.fix: Make the mother from another country (e.g. 'Mi madre es inglesa, pero mi padre es colombiano'), drop 'pueblo pequeño... sur... costa' or the final 'centro' sentence so (b) has one answer.

spanish.r-short.e1.0009.problem: Text is incoherent: Machu Picchu appears with no trip mentioned (a sentence seems dropped), and a Uruguayan says his favourite foreign-study language is 'el español'.
spanish.r-short.e1.0009.fix: Add 'El año pasado viajé a Perú con mi clase.' before the Machu Picchu sentence and change the favourite language to e.g. 'el francés' (or study languages to inglés y alemán with favourite inglés), updating (b).

spanish.r-short.e2.0009.problem: A sentence introducing the friend is missing: 'Al final del Ramadán me invitó...' has no subject, and Q(d) refers to 'su amiga' who never appears in the text.
spanish.r-short.e2.0009.fix: Insert e.g. 'Mi mejor amiga, Amira, es musulmana.' before the Ramadán sentence.
